name: Migration planner: default $29 -> $39 on seats 1,1,3 is +$50.00 MRR
description: FR3/R9. Default inputs must yield 3 affected customers, MRR $145.00 -> $195.00, change +$50.00. Reaches the page through the top navigation so it works on any preview URL.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, then click the 'Migration' link in the top navigation bar
Assert the heading 'Price migration planner' is visible
Assert 'MRR before' shows exactly $145.00 and 'MRR after' shows exactly $195.00
